anatomy.note: Stylized non-human cactus character. Proportions are measured from the admitted front, rear and side references; face uses only eyes and brows.

authoringInstruction: Open overlayImage and read the reference against its head-unit ticks, thirds grid, face-line guides, shoulder/hip lines, and center axis.
